name: Two at the Club
summary: One continuous shot from his seat in an upscale club. She walks in and kneels between his legs, a second woman joins her, and the back half is the two of them kissing while one fondles him through his shorts (Jeremy, 2026-10-28: feature the kissing more prominently). His legs are the Velvet Lounge legs - seated on a sofa - not the source's legs stretched out on the floor. 2026-10-29: legs slowed - one slow action each, 'slowly' in every line, a steady camera in place of the handheld sway, and as few legs as the 6 s cap allows. The face blurred mid-gesture and drifted a little more at every handoff.
